chooseUsername.title: Choose your username

media.add: Add a photo, GIF or video
media.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP photo (up to {{imageMax}} MB), GIF (up to {{gifMax}} MB) or MP4 or WebM video (up to {{videoMax}} MB). The text is optional when you attach something.

feed.title: Feed
feed.subtitle: Your tweets and those of people you follow first; then everyone else's, newest first.

following.title: Following

following.subtitle_other: You follow {{count}} people, in alphabetical order.

followers.subtitle_one: {{count}} person follows you, in alphabetical order.
followers.subtitle_other: {{count}} people follow you, in alphabetical order.
followers.emptyMessage: Publish your first dispatches so people can find you.

user.notFoundMessage: There is no account with the username @{{username}}.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: This dispatch got lost on the way: the address doesn't exist.

errors.auth/not-authenticated: Your session ended. Please log in again.
errors.auth/permission-denied: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.auth/too-many-attempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.auth/login-cancelled: You closed the Google window before finishing.
errors.auth/popup-blocked: Your browser blocked the Google window. Allow pop-ups and try again.
errors.network/unavailable: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.user/email-taken: An account with that email already exists.
errors.user/username-already-set: Your account already has a username.
errors.pagination/invalid-cursor: This page couldn't be loaded. Go back to the first one.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.validation/full-name-too-long: The name can be at most {{fullNameMax}} characters long.
errors.validation/username-invalid: Use {{usernameMin}} to {{usernameMax}} characters: letters, numbers and _.
errors.validation/email-invalid: Enter a valid email, like name@domain.com.
errors.validation/password-too-short: The password must be at least {{passwordMin}} characters long.
errors.validation/tweet-too-long: The tweet can be at most {{tweetMax}} characters long.
errors.validation/media-unsupported: That file isn't supported. Use a JPG, PNG or WebP photo, a GIF, or an MP4 or WebM video.
errors.validation/media-too-large: The file is too large. Maximum: {{imageMax}} MB for photos, {{gifMax}} MB for GIFs and {{videoMax}} MB for video.
